text:
Maria C.: handing off - morning shift (US-west). quick summary: we had a flurry of 503/timeout errors hitting hosted inference for a subset of traffic between 08:12-08:34 PT. paging fired twice. primary paged: @alex, secondary: @priya. Incident created by incident-bot: INC-2028-45.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2028-45 created at 2028-04-01T08:13:00Z. Severity: P2. Pager: Alex R.

Alex R.: saw increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate from a handful of customers (latency at 95p jumped to ~1.2s then errors). Initial spikes correlated with a model rollout we started at 08:10 PT to 2% traffic.

Priya S.: I already reverted the rollout to previous model at 08:18 PT (deploy-bot shows rollback). After rollback errors dropped but we still saw intermittent errors for ~10 more minutes. Might be cascade from cache shards.

deploy-bot: Rollback complete: rollback model xg-v1-2028-03-29 -> previous stable at 2028-04-01T08:18:32Z.

Jordan L.: I noticed unusual KV cache miss rates on shard kvc-7 starting 08:14 PT. Memory pressure on kvc-7 nodes was high (OOM-kill count bump). Suspect a regression in batching behavior with the new model.

Sam T.: spun a temporary extra kvc replica set (kvc-7b) and rebalanced traffic at 08:22 PT. That brought 5xx down to normal within ~6 mins.

Maria C.: impact: ~12 customers experienced transient failures, estimated 15% error rate on their requests during the window. No broad customer outage, but visible errors on high-qps routes. Ticket INC-2028-45 updated with impacted customer IDs (internal).

Alex R.: Actions taken: rollback model, add kvc replica, throttle batching window for us-west pool. See runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving/kv-cache-memory.

Priya S.: Patching suggested fix: revert new batch-aggregation flag set in canary. Flag name: enable_agg_v2=false. I pushed the config override at 08:27 PT.

Maria C.: current status at handoff (08:45 PT): 1) 5xx rate normalized. 2) kvc-7 stable after replica and rebalancing. 3) rollback confirmed. 4) monitoring alerts suppressed and related paging closed.

Alex R.: follow-ups: - investigate batching diff that caused memory blowout (assigned Alex). - run replay test against kvc-7 with high prefix churn (assigned Jordan). - add automated canary kill-switch if 5xx > 5% in 2m for model rollouts (assigned Priya).

Priya S.: I'll open a PR with the kill-switch config and add e2e test for batching in canary harness. Estimated PR by EOD.

Sam T.: I'll leave the extra kvc-7b replica in place until midnight PT unless Jordan says the replay is clean; cost note: ~0.2 GPU-hours.

Jordan L.: replay scheduled in staging at 10:30 PT. Will run multi-tenant sim for 30m and report.

Maria C.: runbook/checklist references: - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving/model-rollouts - https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving/kv-cache-memory - pagerduty: https://pd.redwood.com/incidents/INC-2028-45 (internal access)

Maria C.: ownership for next 12h: primary oncall Alex R., secondary Priya S., escalation @sam for infra. Coverage gap: none planned, but if Alex out for >30m escalate directly to Priya.

Alex R.: adding specific commands I used to rebalance kvc (paste as-is):
```bash
# drain traffic from kvc-7 to kvc-7b
redwood-kvctl rebalance --from kvc-7 --to kvc-7b --percent 40 --timeout 300
# watch health
redwood-kvctl health kvc-7 kvc-7b
```

Priya S.: note for oncall: if you see 5xx spike after a model rollout, first step: pause rollout (deploy-bot rollback) -> check KV cache memory -> add temp replica if OOMs present -> throttle batch window -> escalate. That's the short runbook path.

Maria C.: post-incident tasks (owners): Alex - deep dive and batching root cause (ETA 48h). Jordan - replay + validation (ETA 24h). Priya - kill-switch PR and canary tests (ETA EOD). Sam - cleanup extra replica after validation (ETA after Jordan ok). I'll create follow-up tickets and link to the incident.

Alex R.: closing notes: customer comms not required at this stage, but we should be ready if any customer opens a support case referencing increased errors.

Maria C.: handing off now. If anything pops, page Alex first, Priya second. See you all onstandby for the morning. :coffee:
